 Through: Mr. Sahib Gurdeep S

 ve

 And Ors 
 Through: Ms. Rhea Verma, Ad
 4.
 Ms. Pratima N. Lakra, Cgsc 
 Prajapati and Ms. Yashika G
 Uoi. 
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Jyoti Singh
 Order 
% 18.07.2024 1. This application has been preferred on behalf of Petitioner seeking a direction to Respondent No.1 to reserve a post of Joint Director during the pendency of the present writ petition. 
2. Issue notice. 
3. Learned counsels, as above, accept notice on behalf of Respondents. 
4. The application is disposed of by observing that any appointment made to the post of Joint Director during the pendency of the present writ petition, will be subject to the outcome of this petition. 
This is a digitally signed order.
